items.html:
Aminuddin Ramly, an right-hand allrounder who bowls medium pace, began playing cricket at the age of 11 and has represented Malaysia from the Under-13 level onwards. Ramly had an example in his family for his older brother plays for Malaysia's national side. Ramly would like to be an accountant in the future.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
